# Unravel Counselling

Unravel Counselling is a virtual counselling practice for adults located in British Columbia, Canada.

Key facts:
- Founder and counsellor: Theekshitha Vadladi
- Delivery: secure virtual sessions for clients throughout British Columbia
- Approach: warm, collaborative, person-centred, ACT-informed, and trauma-informed
- Focus areas: anxiety, identity, cultural and systemic impacts, relationships, intimacy, life transitions, self-esteem, stress, and emotional overwhelm
- Languages: English, Hindi, Telugu, and Tamil
- Contact: theekshitha@unravelcounselling.com

Helpful pages:
- About Theekshitha Vadladi: https://unravelcounselling.com/about-theekshitha-vadladi/
- Virtual counselling in British Columbia: https://unravelcounselling.com/virtual-counselling-bc/
- Anxiety counselling in British Columbia: https://unravelcounselling.com/anxiety-counselling-bc/
- South Asian counselling in British Columbia: https://unravelcounselling.com/south-asian-counselling-bc/
- Fees and booking: https://unravelcounselling.com/fees-and-booking/
